outcome: Folate concentrations in amniotic fluid, maternal serum, and umbilical cord blood serum
cohort: 175 pregnant Polish women (white/Caucasian) aged between 17 and 42 years
finding: Strong correlations were found between folate levels in amniotic fluid, maternal serum, and cord blood serum, with maternal age, pre-pregnancy BMI, and maternal weight/neonatal birth weight ratio being significant predictors of folate levels.
